description: An annulus made by covering a disc with a background-coloured disc. Unsolvable without understanding that later shapes occlude earlier ones.
prompt: On a 200x200 pixel canvas filled with white (#ffffff), draw a green (#008000) ring centred at (100, 100) with an outer radius of 70 pixels and an inner radius of 35 pixels. The area inside the inner radius must be white (#ffffff), the same as the background. Coordinates are in pixels measured from the top-left corner of the canvas, with x increasing to the right and y increasing downwards.
